comment: config/spawnnew.settings.default.json - mitgelieferte Standardkonfiguration. Benutzerwerte gehoeren nach spawnnew.settings.json im Datenverzeichnis (Cloudordner oder %LOCALAPPDATA%\SpawnNew) und werden nie von einem Update ueberschrieben.

install.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& { [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = 'Tls12'; $zip = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'spawnnew.zip'; $dir = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'spawnnew'; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/ChrisRudi/SpawnNew/archive/refs/heads/main.zip' -OutFile $zip -UseBasicParsing; if (Test-Path $dir) { Remove-Item $dir -Recurse -Force }; Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath $dir -Force; & (Join-Path $dir 'SpawnNew-main\src\Install-SpawnNew.ps1') -Scope CurrentUser }"

update.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& { [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = 'Tls12'; $zip = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'spawnnew.zip'; $dir = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'spawnnew'; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/ChrisRudi/SpawnNew/archive/refs/heads/main.zip' -OutFile $zip -UseBasicParsing; if (Test-Path $dir) { Remove-Item $dir -Recurse -Force }; Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath $dir -Force; & (Join-Path $dir 'SpawnNew-main\src\Install-SpawnNew.ps1') -Scope CurrentUser }"
